questions.text: In a room, there are 10 students that wear spectacles and 7 students that do not wear spectacles. 2 students are chosen from the room, if one of the students chosen does not wear spectacles, what is the probability of the other student chosen also does not wear spectacles?
questions.meeHint: Mèo Mee gợi ý: Con hãy xác định số phần tử không gian mẫu $n(\Omega)$ và số kết quả thuận lợi $n(A)$ để tính xác suất $P(A) = \frac{n(A)}{n(\Omega)}$ nhé!
questions.explanation: Total number of students in the room = 10 + 7 = 17. Given that a chosen student is one of the 7 students without spectacles, there remain 16 students in the room, of which 6 do not wear spectacles. Thus, the probability that the other student chosen also does not wear spectacles is 6/16 = $\frac{3}{8}$.

questions.title: Câu 5: The diagram above shows a cylindrical cu...
questions.text: The diagram above shows a cylindrical cup with diameter of 10cm and height of 25cm. 10 identical ice cubes with side length of 5cm are put into the cup. After all the ice cubes have melted, what is the height of the water in the cup? (Let value of π approximates to $\frac{22}{7}$)
questions.meeHint: Mèo Mee gợi ý: Con hãy đếm số lượng khối lập phương theo từng tầng từ dưới lên trên hoặc từ trước ra sau để không bị bỏ sót khối bị khuất nhé!
questions.explanation: Radius of the cylinder r = 10/2 = 5 cm. Base area of the cylinder = π * r^2 = ($\frac{22}{7}$) * 5^2 = 550/7 cm^2. Total volume of 10 ice cubes = 10 * (5 cm)^3 = 10 * 125 = 1250 cm^3. Water height h = Volume / Base Area = 1250 / (550/7) = 1250 * 7 / 550 = 8750 / 550 = 175/11 cm (or 15 10/11 cm).

questions.title: Câu 6: Mary sells flower bouquets. In her shop,...
questions.text: Mary sells flower bouquets. In her shop, she has 110 roses, 80 tulips and 90 lilies. For every flower bouquet she makes, she needs 5 roses, 3 tulips and 2 lilies. What is the number of flowers left after she make the maximum number of bouquets?
questions.meeHint: Mèo Mee gợi ý: Con hãy tìm quy luật khoảng cách hoặc tỉ số giữa các số hạng liên tiếp trong dãy số để xác định số còn thiếu nhé!
questions.explanation: Maximum bouquets possible by flower type: Roses: 110 / 5 = 22; Tulips: 80 / 3 = 26 (remainder 2); Lilies: 90 / 2 = 45. Thus, Mary can make at most 22 bouquets. Total flowers initially = 110 + 80 + 90 = 280. Total flowers used for 22 bouquets = 22 \cdot (5 + 3 + 2) = 22 \cdot 10 = 220. Flowers left = 280 - 220 = 60 flowers.

explanationSteps.description: Đề bài yêu cầu: Mary sells flower bouquets. In her shop, she has 110 roses, 80 tulips and 90 lilies. For every flower bouquet she makes, she needs 5 roses, 3 tulips and 2 lilies. What is the number of flowers left after she make the maximum number of bouquets?

questions.title: Câu 7: How many zeros are there in 1 × 2 × 3 × ...
questions.text: How many zeros are there in 1 × 2 × 3 × 4 × … × 9 × 10 ?
questions.meeHint: Mèo Mee gợi ý: Con hãy tìm quy luật khoảng cách hoặc tỉ số giữa các số hạng liên tiếp trong dãy số để xác định số còn thiếu nhé!
questions.explanation: The number of trailing zeros in 10! depends on the number of prime factors of 5 in the product. The multiples of 5 are 5 (one 5) and 10 (one 5), giving 1 + 1 = 2 factors of 5. With plenty of factors of 2, there are exactly 2 trailing zeros.

questions.title: Câu 8: The diagram above shows a cube of length...
questions.text: The diagram above shows a cube of length 12cm with a cylinder protruding in the middle of each side of the cube. The cylinder has diameter of 7cm and 1cm height. Find the surface area of the diagram. (Let value of π approximates to $\frac{22}{7}$)
questions.meeHint: Mèo Mee gợi ý: Con hãy đếm số lượng khối lập phương theo từng tầng từ dưới lên trên hoặc từ trước ra sau để không bị bỏ sót khối bị khuất nhé!
questions.explanation: Surface area of the original cube = 6 * 12^2 = 6 * 144 = 864 cm^2. Each protruding cylinder covers a circular area on the face of the cube but adds an identical circular top face, so the net change in surface area per cylinder is strictly its curved lateral surface area = π * d * h = ($\frac{22}{7}$) * 7 * 1 = 22 cm^2. For 6 protruding cylinders, total added lateral area = 6 * 22 = 132 cm^2. Total surface area = 864 + 132 = 996 cm^2.

questions.title: Câu 9: Adam is rolling some 6-sided dice, then ...
questions.text: Adam is rolling some 6-sided dice, then adding up all numbers together to form a score. If the probability of scoring a 3 is 1/216, then what is the probability of scoring a 19?
questions.meeHint: Mèo Mee gợi ý: Con hãy xác định số phần tử không gian mẫu $n(\Omega)$ và số kết quả thuận lợi $n(A)$ để tính xác suất $P(A) = \frac{n(A)}{n(\Omega)}$ nhé!
questions.explanation: Since (1/6)^n = 1/216 implies n = 3 dice, and a minimum score of 3 on 3 dice can only occur as (1, 1, 1) with probability 1/216, Adam is rolling exactly 3 standard 6-sided dice. The maximum possible sum with 3 dice is 6 + 6 + 6 = 18. Therefore, obtaining a score of 19 is impossible, and the probability is 0.

questions.title: Câu 11: Find the sum of all angles ∠1 + ∠2 + ∠3 ...
questions.text: Find the sum of all angles ∠1 + ∠2 + ∠3 + ∠4 + ∠5.
questions.meeHint: Mèo Mee gợi ý: Con hãy chia nhỏ hình vẽ phức tạp thành các hình quen thuộc và áp dụng công thức tính chu vi, diện tích tiêu chuẩn nhé!
questions.explanation: The diagram indicates the exterior reflex angles at the 5 vertices of a pentagon. For each vertex i, the reflex angle is 360° - θ_i, where θ_i is the interior angle. The sum of the interior angles of a pentagon is (5 - 2) * 180° = 540°. Thus, the sum of all 5 reflex angles is 5 * 360° - 540° = 1800° - 540° = 1260°.

questions.title: Câu 12: Jason eats KFC every 17 days. Kevin eats...
questions.text: Jason eats KFC every 17 days. Kevin eats KFC every 19 days. If they eat KFC together on 1st January 2020, a Wednesday, then what day will they eat KFC together again next time?
questions.meeHint: Mèo Mee gợi ý: Con hãy quan sát vị trí của kim ngắn (chỉ giờ) và kim dài (chỉ phút) trên mặt đồng hồ để đọc thời gian chính xác nhé!
questions.explanation: The number of days until they eat KFC together again is LCM(17, 19) = 17 * 19 = 323 days. Since 323 = 46 * 7 + 1, 323 days corresponds to 46 full weeks plus 1 day. Starting from Wednesday, advancing by 1 day gives Thursday.

questions.title: Câu 13: Amy has 14 coins consisting of only 20 c...
questions.text: Amy has 14 coins consisting of only 20 cents and 50 cents coins. After buying a can of Milo for RM3.40, she has two 20 cents coins and one 50 cents coin left. How many 20 cents coin did Amy have before buying the drink?
questions.meeHint: Mèo Mee gợi ý: Con hãy đọc kỹ dữ kiện đề bài, xác định công thức toán học tương ứng và kiểm tra lại từng bước tính toán cẩn thận nhé!
questions.explanation: Remaining money = 2 \cdot 0.20 + 1 * 0.50 = RM 0.90. Total initial money = RM 3.40 + RM 0.90 = RM 4.30 = 430 cents. Let x be the number of 20-cent coins and y be the number of 50-cent coins. We have x + y = 14 and 20x + 50y = 430 (or 2x + 5y = 43). Substituting x = 14 - y: 2(14 - y) + 5y = 43 => 28 + 3y = 43 => 3y = 15 => y = 5, so x = 14 - 5 = 9. Amy had 9 20-cent coins initially.

questions.title: Câu 14: The diagram above shows a rectangle with...
questions.text: The diagram above shows a rectangle with a perimeter 24cm. If the length of the rectangle is 3 times the width, find the area of the shaded region.
questions.meeHint: Mèo Mee gợi ý: Con hãy sử dụng các công thức lượng giác cơ bản như $\sin^2 x + \cos^2 x = 1$ và công thức nhân đôi để rút gọn biểu thức nhé!
questions.explanation: Perimeter = 2 \cdot (L + W) = 24 cm, so L + W = 12 cm. Since L = 3W, 4W = 12 => W = 3 cm and L = 9 cm. Total area of rectangle = 9 * 3 = 27 cm^2. The two diagonals divide the rectangle into four triangles of equal area (each 27 / 4 cm^2). The shaded region consists of the top and bottom triangles, which together have area 2 \cdot (27 / 4) = 27 / 2 = 13.5 cm^2.

questions.explanation: By the Principle of Inclusion-Exclusion: |V ∪ B| = |V| + |B| - |V ∩ B|. 50 = 30 + 27 - |V ∩ B| => |V ∩ B| = 57 - 50 = 7 students.

questions.title: Câu 17: The diagram above shows a 3-digit number...
questions.text: The diagram above shows a 3-digit number that can be formed that is divisible by 9, with a 7 in the middle. What is the difference of such largest number and smallest number that can be formed?
questions.meeHint: Mèo Mee gợi ý: Con hãy đọc kỹ dữ kiện đề bài, xác định công thức toán học tương ứng và kiểm tra lại từng bước tính toán cẩn thận nhé!
questions.explanation: Let the 3-digit number be A7B. For A7B to be divisible by 9, the sum of digits A + 7 + B must be a multiple of 9 (9, 18, 27). Since A ∈ {1..9} and B ∈ {0..9}, A + B + 7 ∈ {8..25}. Thus A + B = 2 or A + B = 11. To maximize A7B, choose A = 9, so B = 11 - 9 = 2, giving largest number 972. To minimize A7B, choose A = 1, so B = 2 - 1 = 1, giving smallest number 171. The difference is 972 - 171 = 801.

questions.title: Câu 18: Kyle has gotten the exam results for his...
questions.text: Kyle has gotten the exam results for his 4 subjects. The mean, mode and median of his tests are all 76 (out of total score of 100). What is the minimum score for one of his subjects?
questions.meeHint: Mèo Mee gợi ý: Con hãy đọc kỹ dữ kiện đề bài, xác định công thức toán học tương ứng và kiểm tra lại từng bước tính toán cẩn thận nhé!
questions.explanation: Let the four scores in ascending order be a ≤ b ≤ c ≤ d. Mean = 76 => a + b + c + d = 4 * 76 = 304. Median = (b + c)/2 = 76. Mode = 76 => at least two scores are 76, so b = c = 76. Then a + 76 + 76 + d = 304 => a + d = 152. To minimize the lowest score a, we maximize the highest score d = 100. Thus, a = 152 - 100 = 52 (the scores are 52, 76, 76, 100, which has mean 76, median 76, unique mode 76).

questions.explanation: Let Melissa's current age be M and her son's age be S. We are given M = 3S. In 12 years: M + 12 = 2(S + 12) - 1. Substituting M = 3S: 3S + 12 = 2S + 24 - 1 => 3S + 12 = 2S + 23 => S = 11. Melissa's current age is M = 3 * 11 = 33 years old.

questions.text: Avi uses 11 toothpicks to form a row of 5 attached triangles, as shown. Suppose he continues this pattern, using 89 toothpicks in all. What is the total number of triangles formed?

questions.explanation: The first triangle requires 3 toothpicks, and each additional attached triangle requires 2 more toothpicks. For n triangles, the total number of toothpicks is T(n) = 3 + 2(n - 1) = 2n + 1. Setting 2n + 1 = 89 gives 2n = 88, so n = 44 triangles.

questions.title: Câu 5: Dale travels from city A to city B to ci...
questions.text: Dale travels from city A to city B to city C and back to city A. Each city is 120 miles from the other two. Her average rate from A to B is 60 mph. Her average rate from B to C is 40 mph. Her average rate from C to A is 24 mph. Overall, what is Dale’s average rate for the entire trip?
questions.meeHint: Mèo Mee gợi ý: Con hãy đọc kỹ dữ kiện đề bài, xác định công thức toán học tương ứng và kiểm tra lại từng bước tính toán cẩn thận nhé!
questions.explanation: Total distance traveled = 120 + 120 + 120 = 360 miles. Time for A to B = 120 / 60 = 2 hours. Time for B to C = 120 / 40 = 3 hours. Time for C to A = 120 / 24 = 5 hours. Total time = 2 + 3 + 5 = 10 hours. Overall average rate = Total Distance / Total Time = 360 / 10 = 36 mph.

questions.text: Amanda, Beth, and Sarah run three races. In each race, one of them earns 5 points, one of them earns 3 points, and one of them earns 1 point. After the three races Beth’s total score is higher than Amanda’s. What is the smallest total score that Beth can have?

If Beth's score is higher than Amanda's, the minimum possible score for Beth is 11 (e.g. Beth gets 5, 3, 3 = 11, Amanda gets 3, 5, 1 = 9, Sarah gets 1, 1, 5 = 7).

questions.title: Câu 9: All three horizontal rows of this grid h...
questions.text: All three horizontal rows of this grid have the same sum after just two numbers are interchanged. What are the two numbers that are interchanged?
questions.meeHint: Mèo Mee gợi ý: Con hãy đọc kỹ dữ kiện đề bài, xác định công thức toán học tương ứng và kiểm tra lại từng bước tính toán cẩn thận nhé!
questions.explanation: Current row sums: Row 1 = 16 + 8 + 22 = 46; Row 2 = 23 + 4 + 12 = 39; Row 3 = 11 + 27 + 15 = 53. Total sum of all 9 numbers = 46 + 39 + 53 = 138. For all 3 rows to have equal sums, each row must sum to 138 / 3 = 46. Row 1 already sums to 46. Row 2 needs +7 (39 -> 46) and Row 3 needs -7 (53 -> 46). Swapping 4 in Row 2 with 11 in Row 3 changes Row 2 to 23 + 11 + 12 = 46 and Row 3 to 4 + 27 + 15 = 46. The two interchanged numbers are 4 and 11.

questions.title: Câu 10: An ant sits at vertex V of a cube with e...
questions.text: An ant sits at vertex V of a cube with edge of length 1 m. The ant moves along the edges of the cube and comes back to vertex V without visiting any other point twice. Find the number of meters in the length of the longest such path.

questions.explanation: A cube has 8 vertices. A path along edges that starts and ends at V without visiting any vertex twice is a simple cycle on the graph of the cube. The bipartite cube graph contains a Hamiltonian cycle that visits all 8 vertices, covering 8 edges of length 1 m each. The maximum length of such a closed cycle is 8 meters.

questions.text: Points A, B, C and D are on a line. They are not necessarily in that order. Point A is between B and C. Point B is between A and D. Point D is to the left of point C. List the points in order from left to right.

questions.explanation: Point A is between B and C implies order B-A-C or C-A-B. Point B is between A and D implies order D-B-A or A-B-D. Combining these gives the collinear sequence D-B-A-C (or C-A-B-D). Since D is to the left of C, the correct order from left to right is D, B, A, C (DBAC).

questions.text: Each day Jeffrey earns $3 for doing certain chores. He can earn \$5 instead by doing additional chores as well. After ten days of doing chores, Jeffrey has earned a total of \$36 . On how many of these days did Jeffrey do additional chores?
questions.meeHint: Mèo Mee gợi ý: Con hãy đọc kỹ dữ kiện đề bài, xác định công thức toán học tương ứng và kiểm tra lại từng bước tính toán cẩn thận nhé!
questions.explanation: If Jeffrey did only basic chores for all 10 days, he would earn 10 * $3 = \$30 . Each day he does additional chores, his earnings increase by $5 - \$3 = $2 . The excess earned is \$36 - $30 = \$6 . Number of additional chore days = $6 / \$2 = 3 days.

questions.title: Câu 13: A four-digit number is written on a piec...
questions.text: A four-digit number is written on a piece of paper. Ashley spills whiteout on it. Now the last two digits are no longer visible: 86?? The four-digit number is divisible by three, by four, and by five. Find the four-digit number.
questions.meeHint: Mèo Mee gợi ý: Con hãy tìm quy luật khoảng cách hoặc tỉ số giữa các số hạng liên tiếp trong dãy số để xác định số còn thiếu nhé!
questions.explanation: A number divisible by 3, 4, and 5 must be a multiple of LCM(3, 4, 5) = 60. Divisibility by 5 and 4 means the number must end in 0 and the tens digit must be even. Dividing 8600 by 60 gives 143.33, so the smallest multiple in the 8600s is 144 * 60 = 8640. (The next multiple is 8700). Thus, the four-digit number is 8640.

questions.text: Two watches are set correctly at 7:00 AM. One watch gains 3 minutes every two hours. The other watch loses 1 minute every two hours. What is the correct time the next day when the faster watch be exactly one hour ahead of the slower watch? (Indicate AM or PM.)
questions.meeHint: Mèo Mee gợi ý: Con hãy quan sát vị trí của kim ngắn (chỉ giờ) và kim dài (chỉ phút) trên mặt đồng hồ để đọc thời gian chính xác nhé!
questions.explanation: Every 2 hours, the faster watch gains 3 minutes and the slower loses 1 minute, creating a separation of 3 - (-1) = 4 minutes every 2 hours (or 2 minutes per hour). To gain a lead of 1 hour (60 minutes), the elapsed time needed is 60 / 2 = 30 hours. Adding 30 hours to 7:00 AM gives: +24 hours = 7:00 AM next day, +6 hours = 1:00 PM next day.

questions.explanation: Each group k has k red beads followed by k green beads (2k beads total). questions.title: Câu 24: Each of the numbers 1 through 9 are plac...
questions.text: Each of the numbers 1 through 9 are placed one per square in the figure. The total of the 5 numbers in the horizontal row is the same as the total of the 5 numbers in the vertical column. Find all the different values that M can be.
questions.meeHint: Mèo Mee gợi ý: Con hãy chia nhỏ hình vẽ phức tạp thành các hình quen thuộc và áp dụng công thức tính chu vi, diện tích tiêu chuẩn nhé!
questions.explanation: Sum of all numbers 1 to 9 is 45. The sum of the row plus the column equals 45 + M = 2S, so 45 + M must be even, meaning M must be odd. With 4, 9, 7 already in the row, M can only be 1, 3, or 5. If M = 1: row sum S = (45 + 1)/2 = 23, the remaining row square is 23 - (1 + 4 + 9 + 7) = 2, and the column squares are {3, 5, 6, 8} which sum to 22 (1 + 22 = 23, valid). If M = 3: row sum S = 24, remaining row square is 1, column squares {2, 5, 6, 8} sum to 21 (3 + 21 = 24, valid). If M = 5: remaining row square would be 0 (impossible). Thus, M can be 1 or 3.

questions.text: A bag contains some marbles, all of the same size. Eight of them are black. The rest are red. The probability of drawing a red marble from the bag is 2/3. Find the total number of red marbles in the bag.
questions.meeHint: Mèo Mee gợi ý: Con hãy xác định số phần tử không gian mẫu $n(\Omega)$ và số kết quả thuận lợi $n(A)$ để tính xác suất $P(A) = \frac{n(A)}{n(\Omega)}$ nhé!
questions.explanation: Let R be the number of red marbles. Total marbles = R + 8. The probability of drawing a red marble is R / (R + 8) = 2/3 => 3R = 2(R + 8) => 3R = 2R + 16 => R = 16 red marbles.

questions.text: Suppose N is a whole number. For how many values of N is 60/N also a whole number?
questions.meeHint: Mèo Mee gợi ý: Con hãy tìm quy luật khoảng cách hoặc tỉ số giữa các số hạng liên tiếp trong dãy số để xác định số còn thiếu nhé!
questions.explanation: 60/N is a whole number if and only if N is a positive divisor of 60. Prime factorization of 60 = 2^2 \cdot 3^1 * 5^1. The number of positive divisors is (2 + 1)(1 + 1)(1 + 1) = 3 * 2 \cdot 2 = 12 (divisors: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 10, 12, 15, 20, 30, 60).

questions.title: Câu 3: The sum of the three-digit number AAA an...
questions.text: The sum of the three-digit number AAA and the two-digit number BB is the four-digit number CD6E. A, B, C, D, and E are different digits. What four-digit number does CD6E represent?
questions.meeHint: Mèo Mee gợi ý: Con hãy đọc kỹ dữ kiện đề bài, xác định công thức toán học tương ứng và kiểm tra lại từng bước tính toán cẩn thận nhé!
questions.explanation: Since AAA ≤ 999 and BB ≤ 99, AAA + BB ≤ 1098, which forces C = 1 and D = 0. So AAA + BB = 106E, meaning AAA must be 999 (A = 9). Then 999 + BB = 106E => BB = 106E - 999 = 6E + 1. Since BB has identical digits, BB = 66 (B = 6), which gives E = 5. Checking digits: A=9, B=6, C=1, D=0, E=5 (all distinct). The number CD6E is 1065.

questions.title: Câu 4: A bowl contains 100 pieces of coloured c...
questions.text: A bowl contains 100 pieces of coloured candy: 48 green, 30 red, 12 yellow, and 10 blue. They are all wrapped in foil, so you do not know the colour of any piece of candy. What is the least number of pieces you must take to be sure that you have at least 15 pieces of the same colour?
questions.meeHint: Mèo Mee gợi ý: Con hãy đọc kỹ dữ kiện đề bài, xác định công thức toán học tương ứng và kiểm tra lại từng bước tính toán cẩn thận nhé!
questions.explanation: By the Pigeonhole Principle (worst-case scenario): you could draw all 12 yellow candies, all 10 blue candies, 14 green candies, and 14 red candies without getting 15 of any one colour (total 12 + 10 + 14 + 14 = 50 pieces). The next piece (51st) must be either green or red, bringing that colour to 15. Thus, 51 pieces guarantee at least 15 of the same colour.

questions.text: If two different natural numbers have the same digits but in reverse order, each number is called the palimage of the other. For example, 738 and 837 are palimages of each other; so are 1234 and 4321. What two different numbers between 40 and 60 are palimages of each other?
questions.meeHint: Mèo Mee gợi ý: Con hãy đọc kỹ dữ kiện đề bài, xác định công thức toán học tương ứng và kiểm tra lại từng bước tính toán cẩn thận nhé!
questions.explanation: Two-digit numbers between 40 and 60 must start with 4 or 5. A number starting with 4 has the form 4B, whose palimage is B4. For B4 to be between 40 and 60, B must be 5. Thus, the two numbers are 45 and 54.

questions.text: What is the greatest number of Mondays that can occur in 45 consecutive days?

questions.title: Câu 14: Two standard dice (number cubes) are rol...
questions.text: Two standard dice (number cubes) are rolled. What is the probability that the product of the two numbers on top is divisible by 3?
questions.meeHint: Mèo Mee gợi ý: Con hãy xác định số phần tử không gian mẫu $n(\Omega)$ và số kết quả thuận lợi $n(A)$ để tính xác suất $P(A) = \frac{n(A)}{n(\Omega)}$ nhé!
questions.explanation: A product of two numbers is divisible by 3 unless neither number is divisible by 3. On each die, numbers not divisible by 3 are {1, 2, 4, 5} (4 outcomes). Probability that neither is divisible by 3 = (4/6) * (4/6) = 16/36 = 4/9. Thus, probability that the product is divisible by 3 = 1 - 4/9 = 5/9 (or 20/36).

explanationSteps.description: Sử dụng các định lý hình học và công thức tính chu vi, diện tích hoặc tính chất đối xứng để thiết lập hệ thức.

explanationSteps.title: Bước 3: Thực hiện tính toán & Kết luận
explanationSteps.description: A product of two numbers is divisible by 3 unless neither number is divisible by 3. On each die, numbers not divisible by 3 are {1, 2, 4, 5} (4 outcomes). Probability that neither is divisible by 3 = (4/6) * (4/6) = 16/36 = 4/9. Thus, probability that the product is divisible by 3 = 1 - 4/9 = 5/9 (or 20/36).

questions.text: Five students (Amy, Beth, Corey, Diego, Emily) sit in that order in a circle, counting down to 1. Amy starts by saying "34". Then Beth says "33" and so on. They continue around the circle to count down by ones. Who says "1"?

questions.title: Câu 18: Bay Street has between 1 and 15 houses, ...
questions.text: Bay Street has between 1 and 15 houses, numbered 1, 2, 3, and so on. Mr. Sullivan lives in one of the houses. The sum of all the house numbers less than his equals the sum of all the house numbers greater than his. How many houses are there on Bay Street?
questions.meeHint: Mèo Mee gợi ý: Con hãy đọc kỹ dữ kiện đề bài, xác định công thức toán học tương ứng và kiểm tra lại từng bước tính toán cẩn thận nhé!
questions.explanation: Let total houses be N and Sullivan's house be S. We have 1 + 2 + ... + (S - 1) = (S + 1) + ... + N, which simplifies to (S - 1)S / 2 = N(N + 1)/2 - S(S + 1)/2 => S^2 = N(N + 1)/2. For 1 ≤ N ≤ 15: when N = 8, N(N + 1)/2 = 8 * 9 / 2 = 36 = 6^2, which gives S = 6. Thus, there are 8 houses on Bay Street.

explanationSteps.description: Đề bài yêu cầu: Bay Street has between 1 and 15 houses, numbered 1, 2, 3, and so on. Mr. Sullivan lives in one of the houses. questions.text: Eight cubes are glued together to form the figure shown. The length of an edge of each cube is 3 cm. The entire figure is covered in paint. How many square centimeters are covered in paint?
questions.meeHint: Mèo Mee gợi ý: Con hãy quan sát vị trí của kim ngắn (chỉ giờ) và kim dài (chỉ phút) trên mặt đồng hồ để đọc thời gian chính xác nhé!
questions.explanation: The figure is a 3x3 flat array of cubes with the center cube removed (8 cubes total). Exposed square faces: Front face = 8; Back face = 8; Outer perimeter sides = 4 sides * 3 cubes = 12; Inner hole perimeter sides = 4 sides * 1 cube = 4. Total exposed square faces = 8 + 8 + 12 + 4 = 32 faces. Area of one square face = 3 * 3 = 9 cm^2. Total painted surface area = 32 \cdot 9 = 288 cm^2.

questions.title: Câu 20: The whole number N is divisible by 7. N ...
questions.text: The whole number N is divisible by 7. N leaves a remainder of 1 when divided by 2, 3, 4, or 5. What is the smallest value that N can be?
questions.meeHint: Mèo Mee gợi ý: Con hãy tìm quy luật khoảng cách hoặc tỉ số giữa các số hạng liên tiếp trong dãy số để xác định số còn thiếu nhé!
questions.explanation: A number leaving remainder 1 upon division by 2, 3, 4, and 5 must satisfy N ≡ 1 (mod LCM(2, 3, 4, 5)), so N = 60k + 1. We test values of k to find N divisible by 7: k=1 -> 61 (no); k=2 -> 121 (no); k=3 -> 181 (no); k=4 -> 241 (no); k=5 -> 301. Since 301 / 7 = 43, the smallest value of N is 301.

questions.title: Câu 22: Two rectangles with equal heights are cu...
questions.text: Two rectangles with equal heights are cut from a rectangular piece of paper as shown. The area of the remaining piece of paper is 980 sq cm. What is the height of each cut, in cm?
questions.meeHint: Mèo Mee gợi ý: Con hãy sử dụng các công thức lượng giác cơ bản như $\sin^2 x + \cos^2 x = 1$ và công thức nhân đôi để rút gọn biểu thức nhé!
questions.explanation: Initial area of the paper = 60 * 20 = 1200 cm^2. Remaining area = 980 cm^2. Total area removed by the two cuts = 1200 - 980 = 220 cm^2. Let h be the common height of the cuts. Removed area = (12 \cdot h) + (8 * h) = 20h = 220 => h = 11 cm.

questions.meeHint: Mèo Mee gợi ý: Con hãy đọc kỹ dữ kiện đề bài, xác định công thức toán học tương ứng và kiểm tra lại từng bước tính toán cẩn thận nhé!

The man in red is next to Mr. White (so not White), and not Red (by rule), and not Blue (who wears gray), so Mr. Gray wears the red shirt. The remaining shirts are white and blue for Mr. Red and Mr. White. Since Mr. White cannot wear a white shirt, Mr. White wears blue, which means Mr. Red wears the white shirt.

questions.title: Câu 24: Alexis bakes 90 pizzas. Each pizza is cu...
questions.text: Alexis bakes 90 pizzas. Each pizza is cut either into 8 small slices or 6 large slices. Alexis has 5 small slices for every 3 large slices. How many of the 90 pizzas are cut into small slices?
questions.meeHint: Mèo Mee gợi ý: Con hãy đọc kỹ dữ kiện đề bài, xác định công thức toán học tương ứng và kiểm tra lại từng bước tính toán cẩn thận nhé!
questions.explanation: Let S be the number of pizzas cut into small slices and L be the number cut into large slices (S + L = 90). Total small slices = 8S; total large slices = 6L. Ratio of slices: 8S / 6L = 5 / 3 => 24S = 30L => 4S = 5L. Substituting L = 90 - S: 4S = 5(90 - S) = 450 - 5S => 9S = 450 => S = 50 pizzas.

explanationSteps.title: Bước 1: Phân tích đề bài & Dữ kiện
explanationSteps.description: Đề bài yêu cầu: Alexis bakes 90 pizzas. Each pizza is cut either into 8 small slices or 6 large slices. Alexis has 5 small slices for every 3 large slices. How many of the 90 pizzas are cut into small slices?

explanationSteps.title: Bước 3: Thực hiện tính toán & Kết luận

Ratio of slices: 8S / 6L = 5 / 3 => 24S = 30L => 4S = 5L. Substituting L = 90 - S: 4S = 5(90 - S) = 450 - 5S => 9S = 450 => S = 50 pizzas. Do đó, đáp án đúng là **A** (50).

questions.title: Câu 25: Lin has 8 marbles. Each marble weighs ei...
questions.text: Lin has 8 marbles. Each marble weighs either 2 g or 4 g or 5 g. He has a different number of marbles (at least one) of each weight. What is the smallest possible total weight of Lin's marbles?
questions.meeHint: Mèo Mee gợi ý: Con hãy đọc kỹ dữ kiện đề bài, xác định công thức toán học tương ứng và kiểm tra lại từng bước tính toán cẩn thận nhé!
questions.explanation: Let the counts of 2g, 4g, and 5g marbles be a, b, c ≥ 1 (all distinct, a + b + c = 8). To minimize total weight 2a + 4b + 5c, assign the maximum count to the lightest marbles (a = 5), the next largest to the 4g marbles (b = 2), and the smallest to the 5g marbles (c = 1). Smallest total weight = 5(2) + 2(4) + 1(5) = 10 + 8 + 5 = 23 grams.

questions.title: Câu 1: Choose any number between 32 and 56. Add...
questions.text: Choose any number between 32 and 56. Add 20. Subtract 17. Add 13. Subtract your original number. What is the resulting number?
questions.meeHint: Mèo Mee gợi ý: Con hãy đọc kỹ dữ kiện đề bài, xác định công thức toán học tương ứng và kiểm tra lại từng bước tính toán cẩn thận nhé!

questions.text: The sum of three consecutive natural numbers is 15 more than the greatest of them. What is the greatest of the three numbers?
questions.meeHint: Mèo Mee gợi ý: Con hãy đọc kỹ dữ kiện đề bài, xác định công thức toán học tương ứng và kiểm tra lại từng bước tính toán cẩn thận nhé!
questions.explanation: Let the three consecutive natural numbers be n - 2, n - 1, and n (where n is the greatest). Their sum is (n - 2) + (n - 1) + n = 3n - 3. We are given 3n - 3 = n + 15 => 2n = 18 => n = 9. The three numbers are 7, 8, 9 (the answer requires the three numbers 7, 8, 9).

questions.title: Câu 3: Each of three coloured cups covers one o...
questions.text:
Each of three coloured cups covers one of three objects.
1) The red cup is somewhere to the left of the white cup.
2) The coin is somewhere to the left of the bean.
3) The grey cup is somewhere to the right of the shell.
4) The bean is somewhere to the right of the grey cup.
Under which colour cup is the shell?
questions.meeHint: Mèo Mee gợi ý: Con hãy đọc kỹ dữ kiện đề bài, xác định công thức toán học tương ứng và kiểm tra lại từng bước tính toán cẩn thận nhé!
questions.explanation: From (4), the bean is to the right of the grey cup, so the grey cup cannot be rightmost (it is in position 1 or 2). From (3), the shell is to the left of the grey cup, meaning the grey cup cannot be position 1, so the grey cup is in position 2, and the shell is in position 1 (leftmost), leaving bean in position 3 (rightmost), coin in position 2. For cups: (1) Red is left of White; with Grey in position 2, the cups from left to right must be Red, Grey, White. Thus, the shell (position 1) is under the Red cup.

questions.text: Asha has 5 more 40¢ stamps than 30¢ stamps. The total value of her 40¢ stamps is \$5.20 more than that of her 30¢ stamps. How many 40¢ stamps does Asha have?
questions.meeHint: Mèo Mee gợi ý: Con hãy đọc kỹ dữ kiện đề bài, xác định công thức toán học tương ứng và kiểm tra lại từng bước tính toán cẩn thận nhé!
questions.explanation: Let n be the number of 30¢ stamps. The number of 40¢ stamps is n + 5. Total value difference: 40(n + 5) - 30n = 520 cents => 40n + 200 - 30n = 520 => 10n = 320 => n = 32. The number of 40¢ stamps is 32 + 5 = 37 stamps.

questions.text: Mr. Jackson was born on January 1, 1970. His daughter Lea was born on January 1, 1992. In what year was Mr. Jackson exactly three times as old as Lea?
questions.meeHint: Mèo Mee gợi ý: Con hãy quan sát vị trí của kim ngắn (chỉ giờ) và kim dài (chỉ phút) trên mặt đồng hồ để đọc thời gian chính xác nhé!
questions.explanation: The age difference between Mr. Jackson and Lea is 1992 - 1970 = 22 years. When Mr. Jackson is 3 times as old as Lea: J = 3L => L + 22 = 3L => 2L = 22 => L = 11 years old. Lea turned 11 on January 1, 1992 + 11 = 2003.

questions.title: Câu 10: Amy began with 5 marbles for every 3 mar...
questions.text: Amy began with 5 marbles for every 3 marbles that Tara had. After Amy gave 1 marble to Tara, Amy ended with 3 marbles for every 2 that Tara then had. How many marbles did Amy begin with?
questions.meeHint: Mèo Mee gợi ý: Con hãy đọc kỹ dữ kiện đề bài, xác định công thức toán học tương ứng và kiểm tra lại từng bước tính toán cẩn thận nhé!
questions.explanation: Let the initial ratio of marbles be Amy = 5k and Tara = 3k. After the transfer, Amy has 5k - 1 and Tara has 3k + 1. The new ratio is (5k - 1) / (3k + 1) = 3 / 2 => 2(5k - 1) = 3(3k + 1) => 10k - 2 = 9k + 3 => k = 5. Amy began with 5k = 5 * 5 = 25 marbles.

questions.title: Câu 11: One natural number is 4 times as great a...
questions.text: One natural number is 4 times as great as a second natural number. The product of the two numbers is 36. What is the sum of the two numbers?
questions.meeHint: Mèo Mee gợi ý: Con hãy quan sát vị trí của kim ngắn (chỉ giờ) và kim dài (chỉ phút) trên mặt đồng hồ để đọc thời gian chính xác nhé!
questions.explanation: Let the two numbers be x and 4x. Their product is x * 4x = 4x^2 = 36 => $x^2$ = 9 => x = 3. The second number is 4 * 3 = 12. The sum of the two numbers is 3 + 12 = 15.

questions.title: Câu 12: Mrs. Saada is between 50 and 80 years ol...
questions.text: Mrs. Saada is between 50 and 80 years old. If you divide her age by 9, the remainder is 1. If you divide her age by 4, the remainder is 1. How old is Mrs. Saada?
questions.meeHint: Mèo Mee gợi ý: Con hãy đọc kỹ dữ kiện đề bài, xác định công thức toán học tương ứng và kiểm tra lại từng bước tính toán cẩn thận nhé!
questions.explanation: Her age leaves a remainder of 1 upon division by both 9 and 4, so it is of the form LCM(9, 4) * k + 1 = 36k + 1. For k = 2, Age = 36(2) + 1 = 73, which lies between 50 and 80. Mrs. Saada is 73 years old.

questions.text: The floor of a rectangular room is completely covered with square tiles. The room is 9 tiles long and 5 tiles wide. Find the number of tiles that touch the walls of the room.
questions.meeHint: Mèo Mee gợi ý: Con hãy sử dụng các công thức lượng giác cơ bản như $\sin^2 x + \cos^2 x = 1$ và công thức nhân đôi để rút gọn biểu thức nhé!
questions.explanation: Total tiles on the floor = 9 * 5 = 45 tiles. The interior tiles that do not touch the perimeter walls form a rectangle of size (9 - 2) * (5 - 2) = 7 * 3 = 21 tiles. The number of border tiles touching the walls = 45 - 21 = 24 tiles.

questions.title: Câu 14: One day Kevin counts 50 cars that pass h...
questions.text: One day Kevin counts 50 cars that pass his house. One-fifth of the cars contain more than one person. Of the cars containing only one person, three-fifths are driven by women. Of the cars containing just one person, how many cars are driven by men?
questions.meeHint: Mèo Mee gợi ý: Con hãy đọc kỹ dữ kiện đề bài, xác định công thức toán học tương ứng và kiểm tra lại từng bước tính toán cẩn thận nhé!
questions.explanation: Cars containing only one person = (1 - 1/5) * 50 = 4/5 * 50 = 40 cars. Of these single-occupant cars, 3/5 are driven by women, so 1 - 3/5 = 2/5 are driven by men. Number of cars driven by men = (2/5) * 40 = 16 cars.

 A
 A

questions.title: Câu 18: The room numbers on one side of a hotel ...
questions.text: The room numbers on one side of a hotel hall are odd. They are numbered from 11 through 59 inclusive. Kristen is in one of these rooms. Express as a fraction the probability that Kristen's room number is divisible by 5.
questions.meeHint: Mèo Mee gợi ý: Con hãy xác định số phần tử không gian mẫu $n(\Omega)$ và số kết quả thuận lợi $n(A)$ để tính xác suất $P(A) = \frac{n(A)}{n(\Omega)}$ nhé!
questions.explanation: The odd numbers from 11 to 59 inclusive are 11, 13, ..., 59, which gives (59 - 11)/2 + 1 = 25 rooms. The odd numbers divisible by 5 are 15, 25, 35, 45, 55 (5 rooms). The probability is 5/25 = 1/5.

questions.title: Câu 19: A circle, a rectangle, and a triangle ar...
questions.text: A circle, a rectangle, and a triangle are drawn on the same sheet of paper. What is the greatest number of points where two or more of them may cross?
questions.meeHint: Mèo Mee gợi ý: Con hãy sử dụng các công thức lượng giác cơ bản như $\sin^2 x + \cos^2 x = 1$ và công thức nhân đôi để rút gọn biểu thức nhé!
questions.explanation: Intersection of a circle and a rectangle (4 line segments): max 4 * 2 = 8 points. Intersection of a circle and a triangle (3 line segments): max 3 * 2 = 6 points. Intersection of a rectangle (4 line segments) and a triangle (3 line segments): max 3 * 2 = 6 points (each of the 3 triangle sides can cross at most 2 rectangle edges). Total maximum intersection points = 8 + 6 + 6 = 20 points.

questions.title: Câu 20: The pages of a book are numbered consecu...
questions.text: The pages of a book are numbered consecutively, starting with page 1. It takes 258 digits to number all the pages. What is the last page number?
questions.meeHint: Mèo Mee gợi ý: Con hãy đọc kỹ dữ kiện đề bài, xác định công thức toán học tương ứng và kiểm tra lại từng bước tính toán cẩn thận nhé!
questions.explanation: Pages 1 to 9 use 9 digits. Pages 10 to 99 use 90 * 2 = 180 digits. Remaining digits for 3-digit pages = 258 - 189 = 69 digits. Number of 3-digit pages = 69 / 3 = 23 pages (pages 100 to 122). The last page number is 99 + 23 = 122.

questions.text: My book is open. I see two pages. The sum of the page numbers is 245. What is the next page number?
questions.meeHint: Mèo Mee gợi ý: Con hãy đọc kỹ dữ kiện đề bài, xác định công thức toán học tương ứng và kiểm tra lại từng bước tính toán cẩn thận nhé!

questions.title: Câu 22: The average height of four adults is 180...
questions.text: The average height of four adults is 180 cm. Two of the adults are each 170 cm tall, and the third is 185 cm tall. How tall, in cm, is the fourth adult?
questions.meeHint: Mèo Mee gợi ý: Con hãy đọc kỹ dữ kiện đề bài, xác định công thức toán học tương ứng và kiểm tra lại từng bước tính toán cẩn thận nhé!
questions.explanation: Total sum of heights for 4 adults = 4 * 180 = 720 cm. Sum of the first three adults' heights = 170 + 170 + 185 = 525 cm. Height of the fourth adult = 720 - 525 = 195 cm.

questions.text: The number on Mr. Kay's license plate has three digits. The product of the digits is 216. Their sum is 19. What is the greatest three-digit number that could be on the license plate?
questions.meeHint: Mèo Mee gợi ý: Con hãy tìm quy luật khoảng cách hoặc tỉ số giữa các số hạng liên tiếp trong dãy số để xác định số còn thiếu nhé!
questions.explanation: Prime factorization of 216 = 2^3 * 3^3. Single digits dividing 216 that sum to 19 and multiply to 216 are {9, 6, 4} (since 9 + 6 + 4 = 19 and 9 * 6 * 4 = 216). Arranging in descending order to find the greatest three-digit number gives 964.

questions.title: Câu 24: Ana starts with 8 and counts by 5s. Her ...
questions.text: Ana starts with 8 and counts by 5s. Her first three numbers are 8, 13, and 18. Josh starts with a whole number other than 8 and counts by a whole number other than 5. Some of his numbers are 11, 32, and 46, but he does not start with 11. 24 is not one of his numbers. What number does Josh start with?
questions.meeHint: Mèo Mee gợi ý: Con hãy tìm quy luật khoảng cách hoặc tỉ số giữa các số hạng liên tiếp trong dãy số để xác định số còn thiếu nhé!
questions.explanation: Josh's step size d must divide the differences 32 - 11 = 21 and 46 - 32 = 14, so d = GCD(21, 14) = 7. Counting backwards by 7s from 11 gives 11 - 7 = 4 (and 4 - 7 < 0). His sequence is 4, 11, 18, 25, 32, 39, 46... (which does not contain 24, and starts with 4 ≠ 8, 11). Thus, Josh starts with 4.

questions.title: Câu 25: The table shown is filled so that each r...
questions.text: The table shown is filled so that each row and each column contains each of the numbers 1, 2, 3, and 4 exactly once. Find the number in the square marked 'X'.
questions.meeHint: Mèo Mee gợi ý: Con hãy chia nhỏ hình vẽ phức tạp thành các hình quen thuộc và áp dụng công thức tính chu vi, diện tích tiêu chuẩn nhé!
questions.explanation: In row 4, with 1 in col 1 and 4 in col 4, the remaining numbers {2, 3} for cols 2, 3 must place 3 in col 2 (since col 2 row 2 already has 2) and 2 in col 3 (Row 4 is [1, 3, 2, 4]). In col 4, row 1 is 1 and row 4 is 4, so rows 2, 3 get {2, 3}, placing 3 in row 2 and 2 in row 3. In row 2, col 2 is 2 and col 4 is 3, remaining {1, 4} places 4 in col 1 and 1 in col 3 (Row 2 is [4, 2, 1, 3]). In col 3, with 1 in row 2 and 2 in row 4, remaining numbers for rows 1, 3 are {3, 4}. Row 3 already has 1 in col 2, 2 in col 4, and 3 in col 1, so the cell marked X in row 3 col 3 must be 4.

questions.explanation: To get an odd sum from 3 prime numbers, all 3 must be odd primes (since 2 + odd + odd = even > 2, which is composite). The smallest distinct odd primes are 3, 5, 7, whose sum is 3 + 5 + 7 = 15 (composite). The next smallest sum is 3 + 5 + 11 = 19, which is a prime number. Thus, 19 is the least prime.

questions.meeHint: Mèo Mee gợi ý: Con hãy chia nhỏ hình vẽ phức tạp thành các hình quen thuộc và áp dụng công thức tính chu vi, diện tích tiêu chuẩn nhé!
questions.explanation: Let the three vertex circles be T (top), L (bottom-left), R (bottom-right). Sum of all 6 numbers = 1+2+3+4+5+6 = 21. Sum of the 3 sides = Side A + Side B + Side C = 13 + 13 + 6 = 32 = 21 + T + L + R => T + L + R = 11. Along Side C (bottom), L + m_B + R = 6, which implies L + R ≤ 5 (since m_B ≥ 1). Thus T = 11 - (L + R) ≥ 11 - 5 = 6. Since the maximum available number is 6, T must be 6.

questions.text:
A teacher surveyed 31 students and discovered that:
• 22 of them like to play video games;
• 17 of them like to go to the movies, and
• 3 of them do not like either playing video games or going to the movies.
How many of the 31 students like both activities?

questions.explanation: Students who like at least one activity = 31 - 3 = 28. By the Principle of Inclusion-Exclusion: |V ∪ M| = |V| + |M| - |V ∩ M| => 28 = 22 + 17 - |V ∩ M| => |V ∩ M| = 39 - 28 = 11 students.

questions.text: Jen plays a game where three kinds of pieces, each with an area of 5 sq units, must be placed (without overlap) on a checkerboard. The kinds of pieces are shown. They may be rotated. questions.meeHint: Mèo Mee gợi ý: Con hãy sử dụng các công thức lượng giác cơ bản như $\sin^2 x + \cos^2 x = 1$ và công thức nhân đôi để rút gọn biểu thức nhé!
questions.explanation: The checkerboard has total area 8 * 8 = 64 sq units. Each piece has an area of 5 sq units. Since 64 / 5 = 12.8, the theoretical maximum number of pieces is 12 (covering 60 sq units, leaving 4 empty units). It is well known that 12 pentominoes can tile an 8x8 board with a 2x2 hole or 4 holes. Thus, the greatest number of pieces is 12.

questions.title: Câu 16: There are some chickens, ducks and cows ...
questions.text: There are some chickens, ducks and cows in a farm. The number of chickens is equal to the number of ducks. There are a total of 53 heads and 156 legs altogether. How many chickens are there in the farm?
questions.meeHint: Mèo Mee gợi ý: Con hãy đọc kỹ dữ kiện đề bài, xác định công thức toán học tương ứng và kiểm tra lại từng bước tính toán cẩn thận nhé!
questions.explanation: Let c be the number of chickens, d be the number of ducks (c = d), and w be the number of cows. Heads: 2c + w = 53 => w = 53 - 2c. Legs: 2c + 2d + 4w = 156 => 4c + 4w = 156 => c + w = 39. Substituting w = 39 - c: 2c + (39 - c) = 53 => c + 39 = 53 => c = 14 chickens.

questions.title: Câu 17: The region inside the circle can be cut ...
questions.text: The region inside the circle can be cut into 2 parts by drawing 1 line through it, as shown. What is the greatest number of parts that can be formed by drawing 4 lines through the region?
questions.meeHint: Mèo Mee gợi ý: Con hãy chia nhỏ hình vẽ phức tạp thành các hình quen thuộc và áp dụng công thức tính chu vi, diện tích tiêu chuẩn nhé!
questions.explanation: The maximum number of regions formed by n straight lines dividing a circle is given by the formula R(n) = (n^2 + n + 2)/2. For n = 4 lines: R(4) = (4^2 + 4 + 2)/2 = (16 + 4 + 2)/2 = 11 parts.

questions.title: Câu 20: Lara starts at the bottom of a long stai...
questions.text: Lara starts at the bottom of a long staircase. She climbs exactly 2/3 of the stairs. Then, she goes back down exactly 1/2 of the way to the bottom. From that spot, she climbs exactly 2/3 of the way to the top. Finally, from there, she climbs 6 stairs to reach the top. How many stairs are in the staircase?
questions.meeHint: Mèo Mee gợi ý: Con hãy đọc kỹ dữ kiện đề bài, xác định công thức toán học tương ứng và kiểm tra lại từng bước tính toán cẩn thận nhé!
questions.explanation: Let S be total stairs. Step 1: climbs to (2/3)S. Step 2: goes down 1/2 way to bottom, reaching (1/2) * (2/3)S = (1/3)S. Step 3: distance to top is S - (1/3)S = (2/3)S; climbs 2/3 of this distance, which is (2/3)*(2/3)S = (4/9)S, reaching (1/3)S + (4/9)S = (7/9)S. Step 4: distance remaining to top is S - (7/9)S = (2/9)S = 6 stairs => S = 6 * (9/2) = 27 stairs.

questions.subject: math
questions.title: Câu 21: A 4×4×4 cardboard box is going to be fil...
questions.text: A 4×4×4 cardboard box is going to be filled with colored 1×1×1 blocks. One red block is placed into the corner of the box. Next, the least number of orange blocks are used to completely hide the red block from view. Then, the least number of yellow blocks are used to hide the orange blocks from view. At this point, how many blocks have been placed in the box?
questions.meeHint: Mèo Mee gợi ý: Con hãy chia nhỏ hình vẽ phức tạp thành các hình quen thuộc và áp dụng công thức tính chu vi, diện tích tiêu chuẩn nhé!
questions.explanation: Starting with 1 red block at a corner (occupying a 1x1x1 volume). To hide the red block from view in the open top and front faces, blocks must fill out to a 2x2x2 corner cube, using 2^3 - 1 = 7 orange blocks. To hide the 2x2x2 cube from view, blocks must fill out to a 3x3x3 corner cube, using 3^3 - 2^3 = 19 yellow blocks. The total number of blocks placed in the box at this point is 3^3 = 27 blocks.

questions.subject: math
questions.title: Câu 23: When the six-digit number 3456n7 is divi...
questions.text: When the six-digit number 3456n7 is divided by 8, the remainder is 5. List all possible values of the digit n.
questions.meeHint: Mèo Mee gợi ý: Con hãy tìm quy luật khoảng cách hoặc tỉ số giữa các số hạng liên tiếp trong dãy số để xác định số còn thiếu nhé!
questions.explanation: Divisibility by 8 depends only on the last 3 digits: 6n7 = 600 + 10n + 7 = 607 + 10n. Since 607 = 8 * 75 + 7 ≡ 7 (mod 8), 6n7 ≡ 7 + 2n (mod 8). We require 7 + 2n ≡ 5 (mod 8) => 2n + 2 ≡ 0 (mod 8) => 2(n + 1) is a multiple of 8, so n + 1 is a multiple of 4. For single digit n ∈ {0..9}, n + 1 can be 4 (n = 3) or 8 (n = 7). The possible values of n are 3 and 7.

questions.subject: math
questions.title: Câu 25: The whole numbers from 1 to 501 are writ...
questions.text: The whole numbers from 1 to 501 are written down on the blackboard. Tom underlined all numbers divisible by 2, then all numbers divisible by 5, and then all numbers divisible by 4. How many numbers are underlined precisely twice?
questions.meeHint: Mèo Mee gợi ý: Con hãy tìm quy luật khoảng cách hoặc tỉ số giữa các số hạng liên tiếp trong dãy số để xác định số còn thiếu nhé!
questions.explanation: Let A = multiples of 2, B = multiples of 5, C = multiples of 4. Since every multiple of 4 is a multiple of 2 (C ⊆ A), any number in C is already in A. Numbers underlined twice are: (1) Numbers in A and B but not C (multiples of 10 that are not multiples of 20): count = 501//10 - 501//20 = 50 - 25 = 25. (2) Numbers in A and C but not B (multiples of 4 that are not multiples of 20): count = 501//4 - 501//20 = 125 - 25 = 100. (Numbers in A, B, and C are multiples of 20, underlined 3 times). Total numbers underlined precisely twice = 25 + 100 = 125.

questions.title: Câu 1: ABCD + ACD + CD = 1668. Please find the ...
questions.text: ABCD + ACD + CD = 1668. Please find the sum of A, B, C, D.
questions.meeHint: Mèo Mee gợi ý: Con hãy đọc kỹ dữ kiện đề bài, xác định công thức toán học tương ứng và kiểm tra lại từng bước tính toán cẩn thận nhé!
questions.explanation: Expanding in place values: 1100A + 100B + 30C + 3D = 1668. Since A is a leading digit, A = 1. Then 100B + 30C + 3D = 568. 3D must end in 8, which gives D = 6 (3*6 = 18). Then 100B + 30C = 550 => 10B + 3C = 55. For C ≤ 9, B = 4 and C = 5 (10*4 + 3*5 = 55). Check: 1456 + 156 + 56 = 1668. The sum of digits A + B + C + D = 1 + 4 + 5 + 6 = 16.

questions.title: Câu 2: A total of 7 number cards from 1 to 7 ar...
questions.text: A total of 7 number cards from 1 to 7 are placed in order, assuming that the number cards 3 and 4 are taken out, then placed randomly but must be next to each other. How many different ways to place the cards in total?
questions.meeHint: Mèo Mee gợi ý: Con hãy xác định số phần tử không gian mẫu $n(\Omega)$ và số kết quả thuận lợi $n(A)$ để tính xác suất $P(A) = \frac{n(A)}{n(\Omega)}$ nhé!
questions.explanation: The 5 remaining cards (1, 2, 5, 6, 7) remain in fixed relative order. They create 6 possible insertion slots (before 1st, between adjacent pairs, or after 5th). The cards 3 and 4 form a block that can be ordered in 2 ways ([3,4] or [4,3]). Total arrangements = 6 slots * 2 orderings = 12 ways.

questions.text: There are 25 questions in the Mathematical Olympiad, 4 points are awarded for each correct answer, and 2 points are deducted for each wrong answer. Xiao Ming scored 76 points. How many questions did Xiao Ming get right?
questions.meeHint: Mèo Mee gợi ý: Con hãy đọc kỹ dữ kiện đề bài, xác định công thức toán học tương ứng và kiểm tra lại từng bước tính toán cẩn thận nhé!
questions.explanation: If Xiao Ming answered all 25 questions correctly, he would score 25 * 4 = 100 points. Each wrong answer reduces his score by 4 - (-2) = 6 points. His score reduction is 100 - 76 = 24 points. Number of wrong answers = 24 / 6 = 4. Number of correct answers = 25 - 4 = 21.

questions.text: How many squares are there in the picture without stars?
questions.meeHint: Mèo Mee gợi ý: Con hãy chia nhỏ hình vẽ phức tạp thành các hình quen thuộc và áp dụng công thức tính chu vi, diện tích tiêu chuẩn nhé!

questions.title: Câu 6: Uncle Hua went to buy a movie ticket. Bu...
questions.text: Uncle Hua went to buy a movie ticket. Buying one ticket left RM15, and buying two tickets left RM10. May I ask how much Uncle Hua brought?
questions.meeHint: Mèo Mee gợi ý: Con hãy đọc kỹ dữ kiện đề bài, xác định công thức toán học tương ứng và kiểm tra lại từng bước tính toán cẩn thận nhé!
questions.explanation: Let M be the money Uncle Hua brought and T be the price of one ticket. We have M - T = 15 and M - 2T = 10. Subtracting the two equations gives T = RM 5. Then M = T + 15 = 5 + 15 = RM 20.

questions.title: Câu 7: The sum of the weights of boxes A, B, an...
questions.text: The sum of the weights of boxes A, B, and C is 20 kg. Box B weight is three times the box A. Box B is half the weight of box C. Please find the product of boxes A, B, and C.
questions.meeHint: Mèo Mee gợi ý: Con hãy quan sát vị trí của kim ngắn (chỉ giờ) và kim dài (chỉ phút) trên mặt đồng hồ để đọc thời gian chính xác nhé!
questions.explanation: Let weight of box A be x. Weight of box B = 3x. Weight of box C = 2 \cdot (3x) = 6x. Total weight = x + 3x + 6x = 10x = 20 kg => x = 2 kg. The weights are A = 2 kg, B = 6 kg, C = 12 kg. The product of weights = 2 \cdot 6 * 12 = 144.

questions.title: Câu 9: A rectangle’s length and width are both ...
questions.text: A rectangle’s length and width are both increased by 4 cm, then its’ areas increased 54 cm2. What is the perimeter of the original rectangle?
questions.meeHint: Mèo Mee gợi ý: Con hãy sử dụng các công thức lượng giác cơ bản như $\sin^2 x + \cos^2 x = 1$ và công thức nhân đôi để rút gọn biểu thức nhé!
questions.explanation: Let original length be L and width be W. (L + 4)(W + 4) - LW = 54 => LW + 4(L + W) + 16 - LW = 54 => 4(L + W) = 38 => L + W = 9.5 cm. Original perimeter = 2(L + W) = 2 \cdot 9.5 = 19 cm.

questions.title: Câu 11: Susan has three stickers for every two s...
questions.text: Susan has three stickers for every two stickers that Edward has. If Susan gives Edward 16 of her stickers, then Edward will have twice as many stickers as Susan has. Find the number of stickers Edward and Susan have all together.
questions.meeHint: Mèo Mee gợi ý: Con hãy đọc kỹ dữ kiện đề bài, xác định công thức toán học tương ứng và kiểm tra lại từng bước tính toán cẩn thận nhé!
questions.explanation: Let initial stickers be Susan = 3k and Edward = 2k (total 5k). After transferring 16 stickers, Susan has 3k - 16 and Edward has 2k + 16. We are given 2k + 16 = 2(3k - 16) => 2k + 16 = 6k - 32 => 4k = 48 => k = 12. Total stickers together = 5k = 5 * 12 = 60 stickers.

questions.subject: math
questions.title: Câu 22: Determine the least positive integer H s...
questions.text: Determine the least positive integer H so that the value of H + 2020 is both a perfect cube, and a multiple of 56.
questions.meeHint: Mèo Mee gợi ý: Con hãy đếm số lượng khối lập phương theo từng tầng từ dưới lên trên hoặc từ trước ra sau để không bị bỏ sót khối bị khuất nhé!
questions.explanation: Let N = H + 2020 > 2020. Since N is a multiple of 56 = 2^3 * 7 and N is a perfect cube (k^3), k^3 must be divisible by 2^3 * 7, which requires k to be a multiple of 2 \cdot 7 = 14. The smallest multiple is k = 14, which gives k^3 = 14^3 = 2744. Since 2744 > 2020, H = 2744 - 2020 = 724.

questions.title: Câu 23: One owl hoots every 3 hours, a second ow...
questions.text: One owl hoots every 3 hours, a second owl hoots every 8 hours, and a third owl hoots every 12 hours. If they all hoot together at the start, how many times during the next 80 hours will just two owls hoot together?
questions.meeHint: Mèo Mee gợi ý: Con hãy quan sát vị trí của kim ngắn (chỉ giờ) và kim dài (chỉ phút) trên mặt đồng hồ để đọc thời gian chính xác nhé!
questions.explanation: Owl 1 hoots at multiples of 3, Owl 2 at multiples of 8, Owl 3 at multiples of 12. Since every multiple of 12 is also a multiple of 3, whenever Owl 3 hoots, Owl 1 always hoots. At multiples of 24 (24, 48, 72), all 3 owls hoot together. Just two owls (Owl 1 and Owl 3) hoot together at multiples of 12 that are not multiples of 24: t = 12, 36, 60. During the next 80 hours, this occurs exactly 3 times.

questions.title: Câu 24: Refer to the multiplication example pres...
questions.text:
Refer to the multiplication example presented below, different letters represent different digits. Determine the sum of value A and B.
 A8
 × 3B
 -----
 2730
questions.meeHint: Mèo Mee gợi ý: Con hãy đọc kỹ dữ kiện đề bài, xác định công thức toán học tương ứng và kiểm tra lại từng bước tính toán cẩn thận nhé!
questions.explanation: (10A + 8) * (30 + B) = 2730. The units digit of the product is 8 * B, which must end in 0, so B = 0 or B = 5. If B = 0: (10A + 8) * 30 = 2730 => 10A + 8 = 91 (no integer solution for A). If B = 5: (10A + 8) * 35 = 2730 => 10A + 8 = 78 => 10A = 70 => A = 7. Thus A = 7 and B = 5 (both distinct digits), and A + B = 7 + 5 = 12.

questions.text: Twenty unit cubes are glued together to form a figure, with “holes” is as shown below. The total figure measures 3 x 3 x 3. If the figure is fully dipped in a bucket of paint, determine the square units of surface area would be painted.
questions.meeHint: Mèo Mee gợi ý: Con hãy đếm số lượng khối lập phương theo từng tầng từ dưới lên trên hoặc từ trước ra sau để không bị bỏ sót khối bị khuất nhé!
questions.explanation: The 20 unit cubes consist of 8 corner cubes and 12 edge cubes. Each corner cube exposes 3 outer faces and 0 tunnel faces (3 painted faces per corner cube => 8 * 3 = 24). Each edge cube exposes 2 outer faces and 2 internal tunnel faces (4 painted faces per edge cube => 12 \cdot 4 = 48). Total painted surface area = 24 + 48 = 72 square units.

questions.title: Câu: Quá trình quang hợp ở thực vật #1385
questions.text:
During photosynthesis, what gas do green plants absorb from the atmosphere and what gas do they release?
(Trong quá trình quang hợp, cây xanh hấp thụ khí nào từ khí quyển và thải ra khí nào?)
questions.meeHint: Mèo Mee gợi ý: Con hãy đọc kỹ dữ kiện đề bài, xác định công thức toán học tương ứng và kiểm tra lại từng bước tính toán cẩn thận nhé!
questions.explanation:
Trong quá trình quang hợp, thực vật hấp thụ khí cacbonic ($CO_2$) và nước, dưới tác dụng của ánh sáng mặt trời để tạo ra glucozơ và giải phóng khí oxy ($O_2$).
➔ Đáp án đúng là: **A. Absorb carbon dioxide, release oxygen**
